product.name: Svaraa Fold
product.body: An AI-powered, voice-first wearable for older adults and the families who care for them.
product.alt: Svaraa Fold pendant worn on its braided cord

setup.title: Set up Svaraa
setup.stubBody: The setup steps are coming in a later release. For now this screen only lets you test saving and resuming progress.
setup.done: All steps done. The setup card is gone from Home.

profile.title: My Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.contactsLimit: Up to {{max}} contacts. Svaraa alerts them in this order.
profile.lastContact: Keep at least one emergency contact.

role.title: Who are you?
role.subtitle: This sets up the right steps for you.

unsure.title: Not sure yet / it's a gift

caregiver.title: Stay informed
caregiver.body: So you hear straight away if someone you care for needs help.
caregiver.note: Bluetooth and location are only needed on the wearer's phone, so we won't ask for them here.

denied.title: Notifications are off
denied.body: Open Settings, turn on notifications for Svaraa, then come back here.

permissions.title: Allow what Svaraa needs
permissions.body: Your phone connects to the pendant and sends SOS. We ask now so setup doesn't get interrupted.
permissions.whyBody: Your phone is the link between your pendant and your family. Bluetooth lets it talk to the pendant. Location is shared only during an SOS, so help can find you. Notifications bring you family alerts and SOS drills. We never use these for anything else.

location.title: Location, always
location.detail: Share where you are during SOS

battery.title: Battery exemption
battery.detail: Recommended. Keeps the pendant connected when the phone is idle.

denied.title: Something is turned off
denied.body: Open Settings, allow what is marked "Not allowed" for Svaraa, then come back here.

permissions.webNote: A web browser can't give Svaraa Bluetooth, location or notifications. You can continue now. Svaraa will ask for these on your phone later, before you pair the pendant.

about.title: About you
about.name: Your name

dobError.invalid: That date does not exist. Check the day and month.
dobError.future: The date of birth can't be in the future.
dobError.tooOld: Check the year. It is more than 120 years ago.

about.callAsHint: Only changes how the voice assistant speaks to you.
about.pacemaker: I have a pacemaker or ICD
about.consent: I agree to how Svaraa hears and records.

consent.title: How Svaraa hears and records
consent.hears: When you speak to Svaraa, your words are sent to trusted AI services so it can understand and reply.
consent.records: Only after you say "Svaraa". The pendant shows when it is listening.
consent.sees: People you invite see your status and alerts, and your location only during an SOS. You decide what they can do.

claim.title: Scan the code in the box
claim.where: It's on the card inside the box, under the pendant.
claim.owner: Claiming makes you the owner of this pendant. You can transfer it later.
claim.codeHint: Three groups of four letters or numbers.
claim.viewfinder: Camera viewfinder. Point it at the code on the card.
claim.cameraAsk: Svaraa needs the camera to scan the code.
claim.cameraDenied: The camera is turned off for Svaraa. Enter the code instead, or allow the camera in Settings.

taken.title: This pendant is already claimed
taken.owner: It belongs to a household owned by {{initial}}•••.
taken.next: Ask the owner to release it, or contact Svaraa support if you bought it second-hand.

pair.title: Pair your pendant
pair.retry: Press the dot again and retry
pair.confirms: If your phone asks, tap Pair. The pendant confirms with one tick and a spoken "Connected".
pair.charging: Charging? Place the pendant on the magnetic puck.

check.title: Check your pendant
check.body: Tick each one when it works.

contacts.title: Set up emergency contacts
contacts.body: If you need help, Svaraa alerts these people in this order.
contacts.limit: Up to {{max}} now. Add more later in My Profile.

contact.title: Add a contact
contact.name: Name
contact.howAlerted: Svaraa decides how to alert them: a call, and a notification if they use the app.
contact.numberInvalid: Enter a valid mobile number for this country.
contact.ownNumber: This is your own number. Add someone else who can help.
contact.duplicate: This number is already in your contacts.

invite.title: Invite someone to help
invite.body: They'll see your status and get alerts. You decide what they can do.
invite.expires: Expires in 24 hours. You approve them before they join.
invite.sent: Invite shared. They will show as waiting until you approve them.
invite.message: Join me on Svaraa so you can see how I'm doing and get my alerts. Open {{url}} or enter the code {{code}} in the Svaraa app.

drill.title: Test your SOS
drill.how: Hold the gold dot for three seconds, or tap the button below.
drill.marked: Alerts are marked DRILL, so nobody worries.
drill.expiredBody: Check that your emergency contacts' numbers are right, let them know a drill is coming, and try again.

steps.emergencyLast: Last option if no contact answers
steps.emergencyDrill: In a real SOS 112 is called now. A drill never dials 112.

call.start: Call them yourself, one by one
call.ask: Your phone's dialer opened. Did {{name}} answer?
call.failed: This device could not open a call. Dial {{number}} yourself.
call.emergencyDrill: In a real SOS the last option is 112, emergency services. A drill never dials 112.

hero.nextIn: Moves to the next contact in {{time}}
hero.drillNote: A real SOS would call 112 now. A drill does not.

history.empty: Run an SOS drill and its result will be kept here.

wearerHome.keepClose: Keep the pendant close to this phone with Bluetooth on. SOS needs the connection.

chat.emptyHelp: Ask anything, or switch to Do to propose actions for confirmation.

suggest.walk: Remind me to walk at 7 AM

chat.doHint: Do mode: Svaraa proposes an action and waits for you to confirm.
chat.reply: I'm here. This is a sample reply until Svaraa's chat is connected.

reminders.hint: Say “Svaraa, remind me…” or use Do in chat to add one.

responses.intro: Quick replies Svaraa can send for you.

contacts.order: Emergency contacts, alerted in this order

voice.title: Voice with Svaraa

state.muted: Muted. Tap the microphone to talk again.

voice.hint: Just talk. Your words are kept in this chat when you finish.

demo.answer1: Light showers are likely after 3 PM. Take an umbrella if you go out in the evening.
demo.ask2: Remind me to take my tablet at 8.
demo.answer2: Done. I will remind you every evening at 8 PM. This is a sample conversation until Svaraa's voice is connected.
